findings.text: The held-by-finished-run duty still composes its sentence from holder_phase read once at derivation and carries no quoted_run, so a served row keeps quoting the holder's phase as it stood when the snapshot was taken; the done_when's 'an obligation whose sentence quotes a run's phase' is answered only for the review-in-flight arm, and the same staleness this node removed for reviews remains reachable for a holder that resumes or is settled.

This fixture is edited by the diff (it now writes the review's live pointer) but is absent from the recorded gate command in the manifest's tests line and from both suite arms, so nothing in the delivery shows the edited fixture passing, and the done_when's population -- 'the tests importing reckon.crew.obligations or reckon.hooks.coordinator_obligations add no failure against the base' -- was never run: the gate ran the new test file plus test_staged_write_inventory.py and test_every_shared_home_lock_holds_across_nodes.py, neither of which imports either module.

_served_phase re-implements the live-pointer read already written in reckon/crew/station_obligations.py:180 (_live_pointer_owner) and reckon/crew/runs.py:1950 (read_pointer) -- path resolution, OSError, json.loads, Mapping check -- rather than extending either owner; the prompt-path rule that the crew facade must not be imported justifies not calling runs.read_pointer, but the near-twin in station_obligations is a second copy that will drift from this one.
